create_review_comment: create a ReviewComment dataclass instance with file path, line range, message, and severity level
create_review: create a Review dataclass instance with review ID, PR ID, review type, verdict, and summary
create_review_context: create a ReviewContext dataclass instance with PR ID, branch name, agent type, and files changed
use_pr_status_enum: use the PRStatus StrEnum to track pull request lifecycle states like pending_review or approved
use_agent_type_enum: use the AgentType StrEnum to identify agent roles like contributor, sketch, prove, or maintain
